purpose: Teach: 心底/まんが/諸々/愛想/すばやく/はまり/ゆで/まだしも

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、心底その夢叶えたいんだろ?
lines.en: Riku — do you actually want to make that dream happen?
lines.style: Direct, leaning in. Genuine curiosity underneath the bluntness. Testing whether he's serious or just talking. Eyes steady on him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、まんが雑誌、何冊持ってんだ、桜
lines.en: How many manga magazines do you have, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflection disguised as a question. Light, almost teasing tone but with an edge — he's calling her out. Quick delivery, not quite meeting her eyes.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、諸々の準備は明日でいいよな
lines.en: Riku, we can do all the prep tomorrow, right?
lines.style: Softer now, checking in with him rather than pushing. Tone suggests she's giving him an out, giving herself one too. Slight upward lilt on the question.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、先生に愛想良くしすぎだろ、桜
lines.en: You're being way too nice to the teacher, aren't you?
lines.style: Wry observation. Not accusing — amused, even. Small smile in the voice. Points out the inconsistency without judgment, the way friends do.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、すばやくテストを終わらせるな
lines.en: You finish tests pretty fast, don't you?
lines.style: Acknowledgment wrapped in casual tone. Not quite praise — more like noticing something true about him. Straightforward, no performance.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゲームにはまりこみすぎだぞ、桜
lines.en: You're way too into games, you know that?
lines.style: Concerned now, dropping the teasing. Warmer than wry — he cares and isn't hiding it. Steady pace, the voice of someone making a real point to a friend.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ゆで卵むくの上手いな
lines.en: You're really good at peeling boiled eggs.
lines.style: Genuine. Throws it out there simply, like she's noticing a small kindness. No big deal in the delivery, but the observation lands. Warm without fuss.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、漫画ならまだしも、ゲームばっかは駄目だぞ、桜
lines.en: Manga's one thing, but you can't just play games all the time, Sakura. You know that.
lines.style: Shift to firm but not angry. He's drawing a line now, not joking around. Steady, direct eye contact in the voice. The tone of someone who cares enough to say the hard thing.
